Interface with readiness and step methods; TombRacer registers the game asset loader sra as its only implementation.
LoadingStage that opens the game's ResourceArchives 16 to 30 and loads their contents.

Raster buffer that is its own ImageProducer for an AWT Image. Body matches several games ImageProducerRasterBuffer.

HotspotTextWidget showing a validator status icon and message. Body matches several games ValidationMessageWidget.
Component scrollbar with up/down buttons and a draggable thumb. Body matches several games VerticalScrollbar.

Interface of Player, Trap and Projectile that PortalBehaviour moves between linked portals.

Marker interface of the widget containers (WidgetContainer, ArrayWidgetGroup, SingleChildWidget).
Interface implemented by ToolkitSprite and passed to GraphicsToolkit.createRenderTarget.
Depth/colour buffer interface passed to GraphicsToolkit.createRenderTarget.
Interface of the OpenGlFramebuffer attachment slots, implemented by OpenGlRenderbuffer.
Base interface of the hardware vertex and index buffers.
GpuBuffer interface implemented by OpenGlVertexBuffer and its Direct3D counterpart.

TextureOperator returning 4096 minus its input. createTextureOperator builds it for operator id 22.
TextureOperator averaging the three channels of its colour input. createTextureOperator builds it for operator id 24.
TextureOperator outputting 4096 where its input lies between two limits and 0 elsewhere. createTextureOperator builds it for operator id 26.
TextureOperator mapping its 0-4096 input linearly onto a decoded minimum and maximum. createTextureOperator builds it for operator id 30.

TextureOperator clamping its input between a decoded minimum and maximum. createTextureOperator builds it for operator id 6.
TextureOperator mapping its input through a 257-entry lookup curve. createTextureOperator builds it for operator id 8.
TextureOperator laying out rows of bricks with alternating offsets from the vertical coordinate. createTextureOperator builds it for operator id 4.
TextureOperator iterating z = z^2 + c per pixel until escape and outputting the scaled iteration count. createTextureOperator builds it for operator id 31.
TextureOperator mirroring its input vertically and/or horizontally by two decoded flags. createTextureOperator builds it for operator id 9.
